title: how I rebuilt my life - invisible illness and healing
en: it's a beautiful day the loop ends are thriving casting a delicate shade over the hills that meld with the soft green of the sagebrush here it smells like fresh mint and sweet florals it's distinct a scent that always brings me home to myself

reminding me of who i am i haven't always considered myself a happy person in fact i'd say since my teens i struggled with constant ups and downs i didn't realize that as i grew and matured things would get better i thought i wasn't capable of finding balance and peace there was a reason for feeling this way and as an adult i saw a doctor and got help from my body and mind but i realize that once you finally heal the wounds of your foundation you need to rebuild that was the hard part

i know i've said this before that i never found a magic solution to feeling unhappy at times no matter where you go it follows you it followed me here this made me consider that maybe occasional melancholy is nothing to fear in fact it has a way of opening your soul around us that can remind you of your beautiful ability to feel and how alive you truly are the first thing i had to accept about my life is that it will never be a consistent string of joyous blissful days there will always be difficult times though there are ways to get support if

we can seek the help we need a friend once told me that we are living memorials to what we have lost loved ones pets our past selves for a long time i mourned the loss of a little girl that was happy and believed in a bright future i thought she had been forgotten in the process of growing up but i suppose it is our choice to let the past strengthen or oppress us and there came a day when i decided to reclaim the story of that

little girl and not let her stay in the past she was still there in my heart and i could let her guide me to a place of quiet contentment now despite the bad days that little girl comforts me and tells me everything will be okay and with that a seed of happiness continues to grow taking root and spreading throughout my world wishing you a day full of beauty peace and love
so hi everyone i hope you liked today's

video i just wanted to give a couple of announcements first i'm a little bit behind on postcards so if you're expecting a postcard from me it should be coming your way very soon but with this week of kind of setting up my workspace and my father visiting i got a little bit behind um so i just want to let you know and if for any reason you have not received a postcard from me and you've been expecting one please email me um now and then i get a postcard sent back to me in the mail and it breaks my heart because i email the person but usually the email i have is outdated and i just never am able to get in contact with them so so please let me know i love to send out postcards and i really want to it's it's such a meaningful way for me

to reciprocate and say thank you to all of you um last but not least also i wanted to reiterate that i only have this one youtube channel and a instagram account i do not have any other accounts i noticed recently that a facebook account popped up that has been reposting my photos and using the same name as me and it is not me so if you're following me on facebook um it is not me please don't message that uh page thinking that i'm gonna reply because um i've been trying to get the page taken down but um i'm just having a really hard time doing it so

yeah i just i just wanted to give an announcement that i um i am only on youtube and instagram and that is it so anyway um i hope you all have a wonderful day or night and that you're all taking care and i'm staying safe and healthy sending my love goodbye are you happy see yes it smells so good you
zh: 这是美好的一天，环路末端欣欣向荣，在山上投下精致的阴影，与山艾树的柔和绿色融为一体，闻起来像新鲜的薄荷和甜美的花香，这种独特的香味总是让我回到自己的家
让我想起我是谁，我并不总是认为自己是一个快乐的人，事实上，我想说，从十几岁开始，我就在不断的起起落落中挣扎，我没有意识到，随着我的成长和成熟，事情会变得更好，我以为我没有能力找到平衡与平静，有这种感觉是有原因的，作为一个成年人，我去看了医生，并得到了我身体和心灵的帮助，但我意识到，一旦你最终治愈了你的基础伤口，你需要重建，这是最困难的部分
我知道我以前说过，我从来没有找到一种神奇的方法来解决有时感到不快乐的问题，无论你走到哪里，它都会跟着你，它会跟着我来到这里，这让我想到，也许偶尔的忧郁没什么可怕的，事实上，它有一种方式在我们周围打开你的灵魂，可以让你想起你美好的感受能力，以及你是多么的有活力。关于我的生活，我必须接受的第一件事是，我的生活永远不会是一连串快乐幸福的日子，总会有困难的时刻，尽管有办法获得支持，如果
我们可以寻求我们需要的帮助，一位朋友曾经告诉我，我们正在纪念失去亲人、宠物、过去的自己很长一段时间，我为失去一个快乐、相信光明未来的小女孩而哀悼，我以为她在成长的过程中被遗忘了，但我想，让过去强化或压迫我们是我们的选择，有一天，我决定重拾那个故事。
小女孩，不要让她停留在过去，她仍然在我心里，我可以让她引导我到一个安静满足的地方，尽管日子不好过，小女孩安慰我，告诉我一切都会好起来，幸福的种子继续生长，生根发芽，散布在我的世界里，祝你一天充满美丽、和平和爱
大家好，我希望你们喜欢今天的

视频 我只是想先发布几则公告，我在明信片上有点落后，所以如果您期待我寄来的明信片，它应该很快就会寄来，但是随着本周我的工作空间的设置和我父亲的来访，我有点落后了，所以我只想让您知道，如果由于任何原因您没有收到我的明信片，而您一直在期待一张明信片，请现在给我发电子邮件，然后我会收到一张邮寄回给我的明信片，它坏了我很伤心，因为我给这个人发了电子邮件，但通常我的电子邮件已经过时了，我只是永远无法与他们取得联系，所以请让我知道我喜欢寄明信片，我真的很想寄明信片，这对我来说是一种非常有意义的方式

为了报答并感谢你们所有人，嗯，最后但并非最不重要的一点是，我想重申一下，我只有这个 YouTube 频道和一个 Instagram 帐户，我没有任何其他帐户。我最近注意到，弹出了一个 Facebook 帐户，该帐户一直在转发我的照片，并使用与我相同的名字，但它不是我，所以如果您在 Facebook 上关注我，那不是我，请不要向该页面发送消息，以为我会回复，因为嗯，我一直在尝试想要删除该页面，但是我真的很难做到这一点
是的，我只是想宣布一个消息，我只在 youtube 和 instagram 上，就是这样，无论如何，我希望你们度过美好的一天或一夜，你们都保重，我会保持安全和健康，送上我的爱，再见，你高兴吗，是的，味道很好闻吗？
